personal.name: Aditya Shedge
personal.description: I create compelling visual experiences through photography, design, and seamless event management. From capturing live performances to designing brand identities and orchestrating memorable events.

about.title: About Me
about.description: As a multi-disciplinary creative professional, I blend photography, graphic design, and event management to deliver comprehensive visual and experiential solutions. My expertise spans capturing dynamic live performances, creating compelling brand identities, and orchestrating seamless events that leave lasting impressions.

projects.title: Live Concert Photography
projects.description: Captured the energy and essence of major live performances including Coldplay, Karan Aujla, Diljit Dosanjh, Aditya Ghavi, and Dua Lipa. Each event presented unique challenges in dynamic lighting and fast-paced environments, requiring precision timing and creative composition to translate the intensity of live music into captivating visual storytelling.

projects.title: Wedding Photography & Design
projects.description: Comprehensive wedding documentation and design services covering multi-day celebrations from Mehendi to Sangeet and Wedding ceremonies. Combined photography expertise with graphic design skills to create cohesive visual narratives, wedding invitations, and branded materials that capture the essence of each couple's unique story.

projects.title: Event Management & Visual Documentation
projects.description: End-to-end event management services from luxury car launches to boutique openings, combining strategic planning with comprehensive visual documentation. Managed logistics, vendor coordination, and timeline execution while simultaneously capturing key moments through photography and creating supporting marketing materials.

projects.title: Brand Identity & Graphic Design
projects.description: Created comprehensive brand identities and marketing materials for various clients, including logo design, business cards, brochures, and digital assets. Combined creative vision with strategic thinking to develop visual identities that effectively communicate brand values and resonate with target audiences.

projects.title: Corporate Event Photography
projects.description: Professional documentation of corporate events, conferences, and business gatherings. Specialized in capturing key moments, networking sessions, and presentations while maintaining a professional aesthetic that aligns with corporate brand guidelines and communication objectives.

projects.title: Social Media Content Creation
projects.description: Developed engaging visual content for social media platforms, combining photography skills with graphic design expertise to create cohesive brand narratives. Created templates, graphics, and visual assets that drive engagement and maintain consistent brand presence across digital platforms.
